models.notes: Cheap, fast volume player, and the one model the blind launch flags have actually been exercised against on this machine (claude 2.1.251). Settings are empty on purpose: the registry records them verbatim onto every sealed session record, and the launch argv carries no knob that could apply one, so a populated block would put a claim about how the run was configured into the corpus that nothing enforced. `--effort` is the real dial when the launch template can carry per-model settings.

Fast volume player. Confirm availability against your subscription. Must stay a full model name — `--model` also accepts aliases like 'fable', and an alias resolves to different weights over time, so a session recorded under one stops meaning what its record says.
Mid volume player. Confirm availability against your subscription.
Calibration instrument: its job is not to find more bugs than the volume cohort but to say whether that cohort's silence means anything.
